s.note: Smoked mullet on buttered toast with lemon and pepper. Bill knows where the fish run.
s.how: Flake 400g hot-smoked mullet (or any hot-smoked fish), discarding the skin and bones. Toast 8 slices of sourdough, butter them and pile on the fish. Finish with lemon juice, cracked pepper and chopped parsley.
shop: 400g hot-smoked mullet or other smoked fish@Seafood

s.note: Pipis steamed open in garlic, chilli, lemon butter, with crusty bread
s.how: Soak 1kg pipis in cold salted water for 1 hour to purge the sand, then rinse. Fry 3 sliced garlic cloves and 1 sliced red chilli in 2 tbsp olive oil for 1 minute. Add the pipis and 100ml fish stock, cover and steam 3 to 4 minutes until they open, discarding any that stay shut. Stir in 30g butter, the juice of 1 lemon and chopped parsley. Serve with crusty bread.

m.n: Hide-Away Tom's crisp fish and chips
m.note: Battered white fish with chicken salt chips and homemade tartare
m.how: Bake 1kg frozen thick-cut chips at 220C for 30 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 250ml cold soda water into a batter. Dust 4 firm white fish fillets in flour, dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 5 minutes until golden. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped capers, pickles and dill for tartare. Toss the chips in chicken salt and serve wrapped in paper with lemon.

w.note: Puff pastry turnovers of apple and raisin with a sugar crust. Baked in the shack's old wood stove.
w.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Cook 3 peeled, diced green apples with 40g raisins, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and a splash of water for 8 minutes until soft, then cool. Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into quarters, spoon on the apple, fold into triangles and press the edges. Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with sugar and bake 18 minutes until puffed and golden.

d.note: Strong black tea with gum leaf and honey, brewed in a billy
d.how: Bring 1.2L water to the boil in a billy or saucepan. Add 6 black tea bags, 1 tsp gum leaf and 1 clean gum leaf if you have one, and take off the heat. Steep 5 minutes, then remove the bags and leaf. Stir in 2 tbsp honey. Pour into 4 enamel mugs and serve with milk on the side.
